text: Security is a vital part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between users and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through passwords or two-factor methods. Input validation is also essential, because it stops harmful code from entering the system. Developers must understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can damage a site or steal private information. By applying these practices carefully, developers can build safer websites and protect users from serious online threats every day.
